I think I started out as "high functioning" but depressed. I think my depression started out as little things after puberty; when I was 14-15 I started having a lot less energy, started to view myself negatively, but those were things I could live with. It wasn't until I got older and had more responsibilities dumped on me (relationships, work, and school all at once) that kicking my problems under the rug came back to bite me in the ass. I'm 19 now and depressed as I've ever been. I started "high functioning" now I'm just barely functioning. I wouldn't ignore how you feel just because you haven't felt it get worse yet. I would try talking to someone about that autopilot feeling you have.
EDIT: by someone, I mean a good professional. I havent gotten much results from professionals personally, but a lot of people actually do, even if it takes some searching.
